text:
Type: low TV console with wooden base
Use: holding a TV and media devices, closed storage; living room, family room
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: lacquered panels with inset fronts, walnut veneer base, solid wood legs
Colors: warm beige cream, medium brown walnut
Shape: long low box with three framed fronts in a row, set on a slender wooden base with four square legs and a long stretcher, sleek and floating
Feel: warm, refined, calm, elegant
Goes with: walnut or teak, beige and green tones, brass accents; mid-century modern or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: You can easily hide away cables by leading them between shelves and out the cable outlets on the underside of the bench.
